how: `visa.open` of SIM::DEV0, with no latency, opens a session at 0 ms (libs/visa/simulation.md 2). `scpi.query_i32` sends `MEAS:COUNT?` at 0 ms, which `commands` answers `abc` (simulation.md 4, point 4); `string.to_i32` reads only an optional sign and digits, so it fails with `string.parse` (spec A.2) and `value` takes the default 0 (spec 7.2), the output `count`. An error with no original code has the code 0 (spec 7.1). Its origin is the node `value`, named by its first output, line 13 of `<labcraft>/scpi/query_i32.lcf`, under the caller node `s2`, line 9 of the program (commands.md 5 and 8). `scpi.wait_complete` always runs its body, but its native nodes skip on the error (spec 7.2): `visa.query` sends nothing, so `*OPC?` never reaches the instrument and its `0` is never read, its session passes through and `e1` carries the error on; `string.to_i32` skips too, and `errors.raise_if`, whose `err` is that `e1`, skips and passes it on unchanged, so no `scpi.unexpected_response` is made (libs/scpi/wait_complete.lcf; spec A.3). `visa.close` is `always`: it closes the session and passes the error on (spec 7.2), so nothing is left open. `err` holds the `string.parse` error, so the status is `error` and `error` repeats it (spec 7.5, 8.2; commands.md 7). The run ends at 0 ms. The check finds nothing (spec 7.5, 8.1).
